description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams, used for specifying search filter parameters for leave entitlement and usage reports in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base class DateRangeSearchFilterParams and incorporates traits for handling subunit ID chains. The class includes properties for filtering by leave type, job title, employee numbers, subunit ID, location ID, and inclusion options for current or past employees, along with setter and getter methods for these properties.

classes.name: LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for encapsulating search filter parameters used when generating leave entitlement and usage reports, supporting filtering by various employee and company attributes.
